name: Rostelecom (AS12389) financial-network sub-prefix hijack
notes: AS12389 (Rostelecom, Russia) briefly re-announced ~36 prefixes belonging to major US financial networks (Mastercard, Visa, and others) on 2017-04-26 starting at 22:36 UTC. The hijack lasted ~10 minutes; victims included AS26380 (Mastercard / Edgenet's 216.119.216.0/24), AS2559 (PSI / federal USPS-adjacent 198.241.161.0/24, 198.241.170.0/24), and others. The hijack reached rrc00 via AS1273 (Vodafone) as the canonical Russian propagation path '3333 1273 12389'. onset_iso is the first AS12389 transit observation of a non-Russian prefix at RRC00 in the data fetched on 2026-05-26 (peer 3333, path '3333 1273 12389', prefix 216.119.216.0/24, 22:36:39Z). 130 distinct AS12389-origin prefixes observed during the 30-minute window; 82 of them outside Russian /8 ranges. The subprefix_hijack detector fires on 7 of them (the baseline only declares the verified legitimate origins via RIB-snapshot lookup). Source URL points to RIPE Stat's authoritative routing-history view for AS12389; the BGP archive itself is the underlying evidence.
